note: Cached minimal patches for Demo Mode. Each diff is verified at load time.

static-js/off-by-one-src/pagination.js-7.summary: Changed the loop condition from <= to < so the loop stops at the last valid index. The total now includes every order and never reads undefined.
static-js/off-by-one-src/pagination.js-7.testPlan:
1. Call totalValue([{ price: 10 }, { price: 5 }]) and expect 15.
2. Call totalValue([]) and expect 0.
3. Run the project’s tests or the checkout flow that used to return NaN.
static-js/off-by-one-src/pagination.js-7.prTitle: fix: stop reading past the end of the orders array

static-js/innerhtml-src/render.js-10.summary: Replaced the innerHTML string with DOM nodes and textContent, so recipient names are always treated as text and can never inject markup.
static-js/innerhtml-src/render.js-10.testPlan: 1. Render a recipient named . 2. Confirm the dashboard shows that text literally and no alert fires. 3. Confirm normal names still render as list items.
static-js/innerhtml-src/render.js-10.prTitle: fix: render recipient names as text instead of HTML

static-js/json-parse-src/api.js-8.summary: Wrapped JSON.parse in a try/catch and returned a 400 with a JSON error for malformed bodies, so bad input no longer becomes an unhandled exception.
static-js/json-parse-src/api.js-8.testPlan:
1. POST a body of "not json" to the webhook and expect 400 with {"error":"Invalid JSON body"}.
2. POST a valid orders payload and confirm the total is still returned.
3. Run the existing tests.
static-js/json-parse-src/api.js-8.prTitle: fix: return 400 for malformed webhook JSON
